issues.title: Only matches when -s follows php directly
issues.explanation: @for_app already checks the program is php. Matching the literal 'php -s' misses commands like `php -t public -s 0.0.0.0:8080`.

issues.title: requires_output = False is wrong here
issues.explanation: Per the maintainer, php -s can produce output when used this way, so the rule should not declare it runs without output. The fix removed this line.
